meta.author: Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur
meta.first_line: āmāra samāna hīna nāhi e saṁsāre

title: Āmāra Samāna Hīna Nāhi
author: from Kalyaṇa-kalpa-taru by Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur

text: āmāra samāna hīna nāhi e saṁsāre
translation: There is no one as wretched as I am in this world. I have fallen into this ocean of material existence and become distraught.
O family Goddess! O Yogamāyā! When will you bestow your mercy upon me and remove the veil (of illusion) O You from whose womb manifests the universe?
I have heard of your glories in the Āgamas and Vedas. You bind souls who are averse to Śrī Kṛṣṇa and subject them to saṁsāra.

text: tāre mukti diyā kara aśoka abhaya
translation: To those who by good fortune have become inclined to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, you grant liberation and make them free from lamentation and fear.

text: e dāse janani kari’ akaitava dayā
translation: O Mother! Please bestow your non-deceiving grace upon this servant and give me a place in Vṛndāvan. You are Yogamāyā.

text: tomāke laṅghiyā kothā jīve kṛṣṇa pāya
translation: How can a jīva who neglects you attain Kṛṣṇa? Kṛṣṇa manifested the Rāsa Dance by your mercy.
You are Kṛṣṇa’s companion and the mother of the world. You have shown me Kṛṣṇa, the wish-fulfilling jewel.

text: niṣkapaṭa haye mātā chāo mora pāne
translation: O mother, please non-deceivingly glance upon me. May my faith in the Vaiṣṇava increase at every moment.
Without (shelter at) the feet of the Vaiṣṇavas, Bhakti Vinod cannot reach the shore of the ocean of material existence.
